about_the_game: Explore a variety of diverse biomes and regions, each featuring unique ecosystems that range from deserts to caves and mountains. Engage in combat with enemies in both close quarters and long-range scenarios! That's not all, you can fly! With a jetpack, you'll be able to reach even more areas within the game, and there are many options for customization and upgrades available. Vulcan features a pixelated art style.
